mapper.select: select from arc_borrow b join arc_archive a on a.archive_id = b.archive_id

select count(1) as total, coalesce(sum(case when b.borrow_status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending, coalesce(sum(case when b.borrow_status = 'APPROVED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as approved, coalesce(sum(case when b.borrow_status = 'LENT' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as lent, coalesce(sum(case when b.borrow_status = 'RETURNED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as returned, coalesce(sum(case when b.borrow_status = 'REJECTED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejected, coalesce(sum(case when b.borrow_status = 'WITHDRAWN' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as withdrawn, coalesce(sum(case when b.borrow_status = 'LENT' and b.end_date < curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as overdue from arc_borrow b join arc_archive a on a.archive_id = b.archive_id
select from arc_borrow b join arc_archive a on a.archive_id = b.archive_id where b.borrow_id = #{borrowId}

mapper.select: select count(1) from arc_borrow where archive_id = #{archiveId} and borrow_status in ('PENDING','APPROVED','LENT')

update arc_borrow set borrow_status = 'LENT', lend_by = #{lendBy}, lend_at = now(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where borrow_id = #{borrowId} and borrow_status = 'APPROVED'

update arc_borrow set borrow_status = 'RETURNED', return_by = #{returnBy}, return_at = now(), actual_return_date = curdate(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where borrow_id = #{borrowId} and borrow_status = 'LENT'
